verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs say the product has a built-in agent for exploring segments and analyzing campaign performance in natural language. That is a direct in-product assistant, but the evidence is a single overview mention scoped mainly to exploration and analysis. The MCP server lets external assistants act on Hightouch and AI Decisioning 'agents' are campaign optimizers, so neither counts as a built-in assistant here. missing for 10: dedicated docs on the built-in agent, evidence it can carry out delegated actions (creating audiences, syncs, journeys) in-product, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: use the built-in agent to explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language
